goal: Run a single web search then synthesize a grounded answer — Arm C sanity floor regardless of task type.
rationale: One frozen linear shape: web_search -> synthesize. This is the simplest grounded graph that can be run against any task. Its purpose is the sanity floor: if the dynamic planner (Arm A) or the router library (Arm B) cannot beat a single-search linear shape on eval metrics, those arms have no value. The shape is intentionally unsophisticated. The query carries a {prompt} placeholder the bench harness substitutes with the task prompt before the run, so the search is grounded in the actual task rather than a fixed string.

params.instruction: Using the web search results provided in upstream state (search_results) alongside the user's original request, produce a direct, grounded answer. Preserve key facts, numbers, and source references from the search results. Keep the answer concise and focused.

metadata.purpose: Arm C fixed sanity floor — single linear web_search -> synthesize
